title: Enterprise Trust, Security & Multi-Tenant Architecture
subtitle: Workforce360 is engineered with tenant-scoped isolation, 19 granular RBAC tiers, enterprise identity federation, and immutable audit telemetry.
governanceStatement: We believe enterprise trust requires absolute transparency. Rather than displaying unverified third-party badges, we detail the exact cryptographic, architectural, and data governance controls protecting your workforce data.

principles.title: Multi-Tenant Sovereign Data Isolation
principles.desc: Every customer tenant operates within strictly isolated logical partitions. All database queries, file storage objects, and Genkit AI prompts enforce tenant-scoped keys at the infrastructure level, preventing cross-tenant data leakage.

principles.title: 19 Granular RBAC Security Tiers
principles.desc: Fine-grained entitlement matrix providing 19 pre-configured permission profiles ranging from Platform Super Admins and HR Managers to Shift Supervisors, Finance Auditors, and Self-Service Employees.

principles.title: Enterprise Identity Federation & SSO
principles.desc: Built-in integration with Google Workspace, Microsoft Azure AD / Entra ID, and corporate SAML identity providers via secure Firebase Auth with mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enforcement.

principles.title: Immutable Transaction Audit Logging
principles.desc: Every administrative action—including salary revisions, bank account updates, permission escalations, and employee profile modifications—is cryptographically stamped with user ID, IP address, and timestamp.

principles.title: Data Encryption in Transit & at Rest
principles.desc: All public and internal network communications are encrypted using TLS 1.3. Persistent database records and stored employee documents are encrypted at rest using industry-standard AES-256.

principles.title: Isolated AI Model Execution Boundaries
principles.desc: All 40 Genkit AI flows process workforce telemetry exclusively within the customer's enterprise tenant context. Zero customer data is retained, shared, or utilized to train external public foundation models.
